_law: NEVER #17 (NO STALLED DEFICIENCY) / MUST #19 (IMPLEMENT OR DESCope, WITHIN ONE CYCLE). A deficit open across two or more deliveries is a STALL and fails tools/stall_gate.py. Every entry is CLOSED (evidence) or DESCoped (reason). Silence is not an option.

deficits.title: assets/engine child-forge inputs for ChimeraBuilder.forgeChimera
deficits.evidence: AndroidManifest.tpl.xml authored in-repo; template.dex GENERATED by build.sh step 5b; on-device android.jar + release_key/release_cert staged by tools/stage_engine_inputs.sh (never committed).

deficits.title: 16 bridge methods the UI never calls (contract debt)
deficits.reason: The contract is complete (0 missing); the 16 are unreferenced, and several are legitimately headless (version, apkVersion, storageGranted, browserClose). Formally reserved as the headless/scripted API; tools/bridge_contract_audit.py keeps the missing-count at zero.

deficits.title: download host is ephemeral (links die when the container stops)
deficits.evidence: tools/serve_hub.py ships a single forced-download server (Content-Disposition: attachment); the durable home remains /sdcard/Darkith/ on the device (SPI-8). Gate: tools/download_gate.py.

deficits.title: build signs with the shared android debug keystore (signer identity)
deficits.reason: Signer identity is the Operator's installed-app signer and can only be matched at install time on the device; not resolvable in the sandbox. The build declares and self-reports its signer (L-15) so the mismatch is detectable before install.

deficits.title: APK compiled/dexed/signed here, not on the phone (on-phone 7-step chain unexercised)
deficits.reason: Named boundary: requires the physical Termux device. The same build.sh runs the identical 7-step chain on-device via build&install.sh; the sandbox cannot execute it.

deficits.title: android.jar used is the Robolectric android-all-14 stand-in
deficits.reason: Named boundary: on the phone the real android-34/android.jar is the binding floor. The stand-in is API-complete for the symbols used; the API-level gate (tools/api_level_gate.py) covers the runtime hazard this could hide.

deficits.title: dexer here was R8 8.2.42; the on-phone d8 may differ
deficits.reason: Named boundary: d8 is R8's dexer at the same version; on-device output is verified by the same dex checks (dexdump presence of every manifest-named class).

deficits.title: exact installed-version delta is inferred (prior APK declared no versionName)
deficits.evidence: This build declares versionCode=3 / versionName=1.2.0-omega and self-reports at runtime via apkVersion() (L-01/L-02/L-03 in tools/delivery_gate.sh).
